description: Gabe Amo is a proud Rhode Islander. Gabe grew up in Pawtucket, the son of Ghanaian and Liberian immigrants. He graduated from Moses Brown School in Providence, where he was President of the Student Senate and received the Rhode Island Secretary of State’s Civic Leadership Award. At Wheaton College, Gabe received a Truman Scholarship for public service and, after graduating, received a Marshall Scholarship to study public policy at Oxford.
